description: Regression corpus for the read-only RouterOS allowlist. All data is synthetic (RFC 5737 / RFC 3849 / RFC 6996 / locally administered MACs). Groups follow the checklist (a-m); i/j live in redaction-corpus.json, l is a property test, m is a lab procedure.

fields.expect: allow = must be accepted; deny = must throw the deny error; either = either outcome acceptable but the invariants must hold
fields.refKnownGap: true = the original implementation does NOT yet satisfy this case; it is a desired behaviour

groups.a: write verbs, abbreviations, case, separators, quoting
groups.d: proplist and detail on secret menus

cases.why: uppercase menu (segment regex is lowercase only)
abbreviated menu not in positive list
fullwidth slash and letters outside charset
ideographic space inside the command is outside the charset
trailing ideographic space is removed by trim(); must not change the plan
a quoted value with a space is ONE length-prefixed API word, not two
quoted value containing "=" is rejected (could mimic an API attribute word)
raw API attribute word as where key
bare .id positional (not a recognised print arg)
where on .tag: if allowed, becomes "?.tag=1" which must start with "?"

cases.input: /ip address print where interface=ether1 and disabled=no

cases.why: percent sequence is literal text for RouterOS (charset allows %)
verb followed by more path in same token
control: log default tail applied by planner

cases.input: /ip address print where comment=x where comment=y

cases.why: monitor of menu not in monitor list

/ppp secret print where name=a or name=b
/ppp secret print where service=pppoe and disabled=no
/ppp secret print where comment="has password inside"
